description: Keeps organizers canonical across contracts, Flutter, React, Functions, routes, media, and product copy while club remains a subtype. Flutter Dart file names, identifiers and localization keys must say organizer: what tool/architecture/rename_to_organizer.mjs would still rename fails, apart from the club subtype and names the generated schema contracts declare. Contract names, TypeScript identifiers and file names must say organizer too: what tool/architecture/rename_wire_to_organizer.mjs would still rename fails, apart from the club subtype and BigQuery columns.

rules.title: Organizer is the canonical entity and club is a subtype
rules.instruction: Use organizers, organizerId, organizer relationships, organizer callables, organizer media paths, and organizer product copy as the canonical authority. Club is allowed as organizerType club, real-world content, or an explicitly documented released-client compatibility projection only.
